title: TUI dependency and history panes
lead: A key cycles the detail pane between details, dependencies (waits on, blocked by, dependents) and the selected item's recent history, all read-only.
findings_note: owner request, session 2026-10-14: bring the TUI up to date with recent CLI features
boundary: **Not in this slice:** editing dependencies from the deps pane (the `depends` field already does that), and a project-wide history view.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The queue marks a blocked row with `!` (`src/slicer/tui.py:255`) and says nothing about what blocks it or what waits on it. `slicer deps ID` and `slicer log --item ID` answer both from the CLI. During a relay, the owner wants to see an item's last start, handoff and reject without leaving the TUI.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/tui.py`: a `detail` field on `View` (`details`, `deps`, `history`) and a new binding in `BINDINGS` (line 30), with a short hint in `SHORTCUTS`. `deps_lines(state, id)` is built from `graph.blocked_by` (`src/slicer/graph.py:78`) and `graph.dependents` (line 94). `history_lines(state, id, limit)` is built from `State.history()` (`src/slicer/store.py:502`), filtered to the item, newest first, in `log`'s text format. `draw()` picks the pane.
- `docs/tui.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `tests/test_tui.py`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_DepsLines_BlockedItem_NamesPendingBlockers`, `test_DepsLines_ShowsDependents`
- `test_HistoryLines_FiltersToItemNewestFirst`, `test_HistoryLines_RespectsLimit`

- `test_Help_ListsDetailKey`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. Add the pure line builders, then the view state and the key.
3. Update the docs and CHANGELOG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The affected tests, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.
- By hand: select s274 and see that it waits on s273.
